outputs.explanation: Panel A shows flow cytometry dot plots (scatter plots) used for gating; each dot represents an individual cell/event, so individual data points are inherently shown. No averaged summary statistic (e.g., bar chart) is displayed.
Panel B shows flow cytometry scatter plots for gating plasma cells; these are raw event-level scatter plots, not averaged summary data, so individual points are already the data being shown.
Panel C shows flow cytometry scatter/gating plots (MBC gating strategy); each point is an individual cell, not an averaged summary statistic requiring overlay of individual points.
Panel D is a color-coded overlay scatter plot of individual cells from different populations (MBC, GC, naive); it inherently displays individual data points rather than an average summary.
Panel E shows flow cytometry scatter/gating plots for MBC subsets; each dot is an individual cell event, not an averaged bar/summary statistic, so the check does not apply.
